coordinate_units: Native full-image y pixels, same origin as the1050x1440 source ROI crop; not resized display pixels
interpretation: Conservative working intervals read visually from the torso outline and pixel ruler. These are neither calibrated measurement-error bounds nor statistical confidence intervals; another reviewer may widen or move them.
selection: Consecutive5-source-frame samples straddling the apparent destination boundary, within all172 inspected original-pixel ruler panels. Uncertain centres are retained rather than replaced by later model boxes.

rows.note: Leading cow in a dense group; adjacent animals and partial torso near exit increase centre uncertainty.
Left patched cow in first group; use its torso rather than the following white speckled cow.
Right dark cow with transverse white marks; first previous B-witness was close to the gate and remains ambiguous here.
White speckled rear-left cow; neck/head outline separated from torso. Keep centre overlap with gate uncertain.
Isolated patched cow; broad shoulder/neck transition makes two near-gate estimates uncertain.
Mostly dark cow; broad hump and narrower neck are distinguished by outline rather than white rump patch alone.
Tiny dorsal white spot is a visual association aid, not the torso-centre definition; following cow is excluded.
Following dark cow; torso outline rather than the small dorsal white marks determines the working interval.
Right member of parallel pair, dirty pale rump; its body centre is separate from the left animal.
Left member of parallel pair, white neck band; centre is estimated from dorsal torso, not the neck band.
Final group cow, large white back; full torso/head boundary remains interpretive.
Later white cow; distinguish narrow neck from the broad torso. The first two near-gate intervals remain unresolved.
